fact: Orange Corners South Sudan, implemented by the Foundation for Youth Initiative with BizEx Ltd and the Cooperative Bank, runs six months of training and mentorship for entrepreneurs; 24 pitched at its second Innovation Fund competition in Juba.

Tech Africa News reports MTN South Sudan launched the Rumbek ICT Hub, a digital learning and innovation centre in Rumbek Town, Lakes State, on 8 September 2026, which it says will provide ICT training, innovation opportunities and capacity-building programmes for young people, with no startup cohort described.
